audit_wave6: Gate F failed on measurement after shipping. An isolated reader holding only the pack and prompt.txt landed the call (the 0.030 cutoff) at about 70 per cent confidence and hit 26 of 30 ask figures, scored by score_reader.py. It read the decisive step off clause 3.4 of the validation protocol, 'Detection is counted per specimen', which is the sentence that tells a reader the design is paired; it then computed both branches and reported that every paired variant gives 0.030 and every unpaired variant gives 0.015. So the decisive choice is a two-way fork resolved by one filed sentence, which is readability screen test 1. The build is still SHIPPED and pending portal review; this is pre-emptive evidence that it will not hold, not a portal result. The repair is to the ladder, not the asks: the pairing must stop being readable from a shipped sentence, which means either removing the per-specimen counting sentence and forcing the design from the records, or re-rooting the decisive step. Raised to the author as a rework candidate ahead of the portal.

resume: architecture 1 spent on measurement; re-root at stage 1 as architecture 2, loops reset, the asks re-cut with it. A stage-2 ladder repair was screened as code and refused on three independent kills. One, the reflex sweep: 6 of 12 textbook routes to an interval on the increase file the golden 0.030, two of them needing no insight into the design (a nonparametric bootstrap over the specimen rows is paired for free because the protocol files the population at specimen grain, and a regression on the screen with unit-clustered standard errors is a house reflex), with the point estimate identical under both estimators to twelve decimals and only the standard error differing, 0.01378 against 0.03029. Two, there is nowhere to move the step: four of the five per-cutoff graded figures are statistics the pack fixes exactly, so the interval is the decision rule's only residue, and every alternative decisive step screened out with a number (the reference standard's own misses unidentified, no specimen under 40 markers; plate design effect 0.725 to 0.863, below 1, so it narrows and separates nothing; all four multiplicity readings establish the same cutoff; the dilution curve and the repeatability measurements each reduce to one scalar correction, a monotone rescaling). Three, guard.py heart BLOCKs test.same_driver_older against task190 architecture 6, substantively and not as the H27 artifact: same decisive gap, same pattern, same Gate G mechanism, both filing a 95 per cent level over a quantity whose variance is then the only open thing, both screening the decisive rung silent, and both readers landing the call and nearly every ask figure. A ladder-only repair could not have cleared the bar anyway: the reader banked 54.7 on the ask side alone against a bar of 50, before the call is scored. Do not draw a decisive step that is a choice between two members of a variance family over a quantity the records already fix.
stump: A competent solver computes each screen's detection rate on the parallel run with its own 95 per cent interval, finds every compliant cutoff's interval overlapping the screen in service's, reads the protocol's interval test as unmet and holds the change, where the same specimens establish the increase at the 0.030 cutoff with an interval clear of zero.
